summary: Implements the entire `agent-effectiveness evals score` pipeline in one 1294-line internal module: schema contracts for SkillOpt task manifests and score reports, a tagged scorer error, deterministic scoring math, fixture filesystem walking plus ts-morph export parsing, three subprocess-backed law lanes (schema-first lint, tsgo, biome), DuckDb/ai-metrics recording, and the command adapter consumed by AgentEffectiveness.command.ts.

concerns.name: Schema contracts and codecs
concerns.description: Fourteen S.Class models and two LiteralKits defining the manifest input and fixed report output contract, plus JSON codecs. Mixes public contract schemas (manifest, violation, report) with private intermediates (SourceFileSnapshot, SubprocessResult, CompletionResult, LawEvaluation) and options classes.

concerns.name: Command-boundary tagged error
concerns.description: AgentEffectivenessEvalScorerError (TaggedErrorClass) with `new`/`mapError` statics and an Options declare-namespace; the single error channel threaded through every Effect in the file.

concerns.name: Pure scoring and violation-ordering domain logic
concerns.description: Contract-fixed deterministic math and ordering: reciprocal-decay component score, arithmetic-mean law fraction, report assembly, violation dedupe/sort key, rounding, and small pure string/path helpers. No effects, no dependencies beyond effect data modules.

concerns.name: Fixture filesystem walk, snapshots, ts-morph export parsing, completion evaluation
concerns.description: Recursive .ts/.tsx walker with ignore dirs, concurrent snapshot reads, ts-morph exported-symbol extraction, regex compilation, and the requiredExports/requiredPatterns/forbiddenPatterns completion evaluator.

concerns.name: Generic subprocess execution
concerns.description: ChildProcess.make wrapper that captures merged stdout/stderr and exit code into a SubprocessResult, plus command-string formatting. Identical hand-rolled variants exist in at least 12 other files in this package.

concerns.name: Law lanes: schema-first wrapper, tsgo, biome (spawn + output parsing)
concerns.description: Builds a temp wrapper package and re-invokes the CLI's own bin.ts for `lint schema-first`, runs node_modules/.bin/tsgo and biome, and parses each tool's text/JSON output into violations, including diagnostic line/rule extraction and path sanitization. Also contains writeJsonFile (mkdir+encode+write).

concerns.name: ai-metrics DuckDb recording
concerns.description: Builds a DuckDb node layer against .beep/ai-metrics/derived, hashes the prompt and config snapshot, and writes BenchmarkCase/BenchmarkRun rows via @beep/repo-ai-metrics. Fully separable persistence concern behind the --record flag.

concerns.name: Orchestration and command adapter with inline rendering
concerns.description: scoreAgentEffectivenessEval wires manifest decode + completion + law into a report; runAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreCommand re-reads the manifest, renders JSON or a one-line summary via Console.log, and optionally records. Rendering is two Console.log calls — too thin to earn a .render.ts.

proposedSplit.contents: Public contract schemas and codecs: AgentEffectivenessEvalViolationSource, SkillOptTaskCompletionCriteria, SkillOptTaskWeights, SkillOptTaskManifest, AgentEffectivenessEvalViolation, AgentEffectivenessEvalScoreBreakdown, AgentEffectivenessEvalScoreReport, AgentEffectivenessEvalRecordResult, decodeTaskManifestJson, encodeAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreReportJson. These are the symbols the test suite and future consumers need; private intermediates stay in internal/.
AgentEffectivenessEvalScorerError class, its `new`/`mapError` statics, and the AgentEffectivenessEvalScorerError.Options declare-namespace.

Pure deterministic scoring: lawComponentScore, aggregateLawFraction, roundScore, scoreOrder, violationKey, sortViolations, firstRuleId, buildAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreReport, plus CompletionResult and LawEvaluation intermediate classes. Zero effects — the most testable seam in the file.

Fixture inspection and completion checks: SourceFileSnapshot, SourceFileExtension, listSourceFiles, readSourceSnapshots, parseExportedSymbols (ts-morph), compileCompletionPattern, sourceFileLineForPattern/sourceFileMatchesPattern, lineForOffset, isSourceFileName, evaluateSkillOptCompletion. Isolates the only ts-morph dependency.

Subprocess-backed law lanes: SubprocessResult, runSubprocess, formatCommand, writeJsonFile, prepareSchemaFirstWrapper, SchemaFirstPolicyIssue + parseSchemaFirstViolations, tsgo diagnostic parsers (lineNumberFromDiagnostic, diagnosticRuleId, sanitizeDiagnosticLine, parseTsgoViolations), biome JSON parsers (parseBiomeViolations and its Option helpers), evaluateSchemaFirst/evaluateTsgo/evaluateBiome/evaluateLaw. runSubprocess should immediately be re-pointed at the shared helper proposed below.

ai-metrics persistence: RecordAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreOptions, recordNote, recordAgentEffectivenessEvalScore with the DuckDb.makeNodeLayer build and hashPublicTextSha256 calls. Only place @beep/duckdb and @beep/repo-ai-metrics are imported.

Slimmed orchestrator kept at the existing path: scoreAgentEffectivenessEval, RunAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreCommandOptions, runAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreCommand (incl. the two Console.log render lines), plus re-exports of the public schema/error/scoring symbols so the existing test deep-import path and AgentEffectiveness.command.ts import keep compiling unchanged.

Package-shared runSubprocess/SubprocessResult (ChildProcess.make + merged-output fold + exitCode) with a caller-supplied error mapper, alongside the existing src/internal/repo-run/ shared module; EvalLawLanes becomes its first migrated consumer.

sharedCandidates.description: Generic ChildProcess.make wrapper capturing merged stdout+stderr and exit code. rg shows the identical inline pattern hand-rolled ~20 times across the package (Quality/Tasks.ts x4, Quality.command.ts x2, FallowQuality.command.ts, ChangesetGraph.ts, TurboConfigProof.ts, QualityArtifactSupport.ts, PackageVerify.ts x2, CoverageRegression.ts, Research x4, Fallow.command.ts, Skills.command.ts, Corpus.service.ts, internal/repo-run/RepoRun.executor.ts x2).

Backslash-to-slash and leading-./ stripping for repo-relative paths; nothing eval-specific. No equivalent found in other command groups, but any group emitting cross-platform-stable relative paths (Docgen, Quality artifacts, Corpus) needs it — candidate for @beep/repo-utils if one does not already exist there.
mkdir -p parent, schema-encode to JSON string, write with trailing newline. Generic artifact-writing utility for any command that emits JSON files.
Deterministically sorted TypeScript source walker; the ignore list and extension filter are repo-wide conventions, not scorer-specific.
tsc/tsgo diagnostic text parsers (file(line,col) and file:line:col forms, TS\d+ rule extraction). Useful to any lane that runs tsgo and needs structured findings.

risks: test/agent-effectiveness-eval-scorer.test.ts deep-imports 9 symbols from @beep/repo-cli/commands/AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer (SkillOptTaskManifest, AgentEffectivenessEvalScoreBreakdown, aggregateLawFraction, buildAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreReport, encodeAgentEffectivenessEvalScoreReportJson, evaluateSkillOptCompletion, lawComponentScore, plus the AgentEffectivenessEvalViolation type) — the split must keep re-exports at that path or update the test; note the topology says deep role files are private, so tests arguably should move to a commands/AgentEffectiveness facade import, which requires widening index.ts beyond `export * from ./AgentEffectiveness.command.js`.

$I = $RepoCliId.create("commands/AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer") stamps every S.Class identifier/annotation; moving schemas into new files changes their identity module path, which will diff the generated-and-tracked p3 schema catalog (commit 5783560) and any serialized identifiers — the catalog must be regenerated in the same change.

JSDoc @example blocks embed the deep import path (e.g. `from "@beep/repo-cli/commands/AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer"`); docgen compiles examples, so every moved exported symbol's @example import must be rewritten or docgen/docgen:local fails.

evaluateSchemaFirst self-invokes the CLI via the hardcoded path packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/bin.ts and reads [schema-first:issue] stdout lines; the wrapper-dir constants (SCHEMA_FIRST_FIXTURE_PACKAGE_PREFIX, packages/fixture layout) and the parser must move together or scoring silently degrades to operational errors.

Output determinism is contract-fixed: sortViolations (dedupe by violationKey then 5-level Order) and roundScore(6 digits) are applied at specific points (per-lane parse AND final report assembly); relocating helpers must preserve exactly where dedupe/sort/round are applied or golden score reports change.

The file and AgentEffectiveness.command.ts are already modified in the working tree on branch repo-cli-modularization — reconcile with in-flight edits before splitting, and remember the branch needs its own changeset for the yeet gate.
